A big consulting firm hands you a PowerPoint report and leaves. Cauce does both differently: an honest engineering diagnosis + hands-on implementation with the same people who did the diagnosis. You aren't handed off to some junior after the sale. There's no surprise "phase 2".

Charging a small amount commits us to bringing you something of real value (actionable recommendations, not a sales presentation) and filters out people who only want to compare prices. In return you leave with concrete ideas you can apply that same day, whether you hire us or not.

textos.<b0>Empresas con software hecho por otro: <b0>Companies with software built by another provider</b0> that fails and they don't know why.
textos.<b0>Ideal si</b0>Vas a lanzar algo nuevo: <b0>Ideal if</b0>You're about to launch something new, or your system fails and you don't know why.
textos.¿Prueban software que no hicieron ustede: Do you test software you didn't build?
textos.Sí. Probamos software propio, de otro pr: Yes. We test software built in-house, by another provider or with AI.
textos.¿Necesito acceso al código?: Do I need to give access to the code?
textos.No para las pruebas funcionales: probamo: Not for functional testing: we test the application the way a person uses it.
textos.Antes de cada lanzamiento o actualizació: Before every major release or update, and when the system starts failing for no clear reason.
textos.Soporte TI para empresas:<i0/><b1>tu áre: IT support for businesses:<i0/><b1>your IT department without hiring one.</b1>
textos.Alguien atiende cuando algo falla y cuid: Someone responds when something breaks and looks after the equipment before it fails.
textos.Atendemos a tu equipo por WhatsApp, telé: We help your team via WhatsApp, phone or email and solve issues with secure remote access.
textos.Vamos a tu oficina, tienda o bodega cuan: We come to your office, store or warehouse when the problem can't be solved remotely.
textos.Revisiones programadas para que los equi: Scheduled checkups so equipment doesn't fail at the worst moment.
textos.Muchas veces nos enteramos de la falla a: We often notice the failure before you do.
textos.Niveles con tiempo de respuesta definido: Levels with defined response times: 24 to 48 h, 8 to 24 h or under 4 h.
textos.Si necesitas computadores, los vendemos: If you need computers, we sell or rent them in Cali with support included.
textos.Registramos tus equipos, usuarios y prog: We register your equipment, users and software.
textos.Corregimos lo urgente y dejamos todo doc: We fix what's urgent and leave everything documented.
textos.Mesa de ayuda y visitas según el nivel q: Help desk and visits according to the level you choose.
textos.Informe de casos y recomendaciones para: Case reports and recommendations so things fail less.
textos.<b0>Ideal si</b0>No tienes a nadie de TI: <b0>Ideal if</b0>You have no one in IT on your team and every failure stops your operations.
textos.¿Atienden fuera de Cali?: Do you provide service outside Cali?
textos.La mesa de ayuda remota sí, para Colombi: The remote help desk, yes, for Colombia, Latin America and any country. On-site visits are in Cali.
textos.¿Qué tiempos de respuesta manejan?: What response times do you offer?
textos.Según el nivel: de 24 a 48 horas, de 8 a: Depending on the level: 24 to 48 hours, 8 to 24 hours or under 4 hours. Response time is when we start working on it; the fix depends on the case.
textos.¿Puedo alquilar los computadores con el: Can I rent computers with support included?
textos.Sí. En la tienda alquilamos computadores: Yes. In the store we rent computers in Cali with support plans.
textos.Los pasos de esta consultoría, de la pri: The steps of this consulting service, from the first conversation to the roadmap. The same team works with you from start to finish, with fixed scope and price.
textos.Diagnóstico, Datos, Procesos e Ingenierí: Diagnosis, Data, Processes and Engineering: our four-stage method applied to your business. It is the foundation for everything else: it decides which pieces you need and which you don't.
textos.Nuestro método de cuatro etapas aplicado: Our four-stage method applied to your business: Diagnosis → Data → Processes → Engineering. It is the base of the tower: it decides which pieces you need and in what order.
